title: 第13章 夜袭第14章 出手
content_zh:
日子一天天过去。
苏牧每日早出晚归，风雨无阻，完美地履行着身为猎户的职责。
点数也在慢慢地积累着。
伏波刀法从小成到大成，需要的点数不少，要三百点，对于苏牧来说是五个月的积累，任重而道远。
所幸目标明确，而且没有歧路，只要做好自己分内的事情，持之以恒，早晚能够抵达目的地。
有了上次孙大招找的事情之后，苏牧刻意低调了下来。
每日打到的猎物，他只带一小部分回城，大部分都舍弃掉了。
虽然有些可惜，但小心驶得万年船，谨慎一些总不会有错。
他暗中打听过，孙大招介绍给邢捕头的那几个猎户，自从去了南城司，就再也没有回来。
苏牧猜测他们应该已经是凶多吉少。
银子虽好，但也要有命花啊。
自那之后，他行事越发谨小慎微。
也不知道是不是因为他打猎足够勤恳的原因，面板上点数的增加速度，比之前又有了些许的提升。
如今两天就能有五个点了。
一个月下来，他就已经攒了整整七十个点数。
“照这么下去，最多三个月，我就能刀法大成，到时候在南城也算个人物了吧。”
苏牧心中想着，在城外奔波打猎一整日，即使他现在体质强了许多，也感觉有些疲惫。
打水洗漱了一番，他就躺在床上闭上了眼睛，为明日打猎养精蓄锐。
…………
今夜无星。

从天空向下俯瞰，整座武陵城都笼罩在黑暗之中。
与内城的灯火通明不同，外城几乎全都是一片黑暗和死寂。
只有少数几个地方能够望见灯火。
其中之一，便是南城司的衙门。
啪！
一个茶杯被人摔在地上，摔得粉碎。
杯中的茶水溅了邢兆福一身，身上那件蓝色的捕头服被浸湿了大片。
但是这位跺跺脚就能让南城震三震的大人物，此刻头颅低垂，一副逆来顺受的样子。
能让素有毒蛇之称的邢兆福如此顺服，那摔碎茶杯的人，自然只能是南城司一号人物，南城司马何玉兴。
“邢兆福，你干的好事！”
何玉兴满脸怒意，指着邢兆福骂道，“半年时间，损兵折将，那黑龙寨却依旧逍遥法外，牵头狗来做这个总捕头都比你强！”
邢兆福一脸苦涩，“司马，我真的已经尽力了，实在是那黑龙寨的大寨主已经是淬体三境的强者，二寨主和三寨主也是淬体二境。
咱们南城司，除了我是淬体二境，其他入境的武者都猜淬体一境而已。
打不过，真的打不过啊。”
“你招募的那些差役都是摆设？就算用人命给我堆，也要把黑龙寨给我堆平了！”
何玉兴眼神中闪烁着浓郁的杀意，“平不了黑龙寨，上面怪罪下来，我第一个收拾了你！”
“司马，那黑龙寨十分狡诈，每次都是躲在深山老林里偷袭我们，不过我已经想到了办法，我会招募一批擅长在山林中活动的猎户，有他们带路，我肯定能将黑龙寨的人一网打尽！”
邢兆福自信地说道。
“哈哈哈，手下败将，好大的口气！”
就在这时，忽然一阵大笑之声响起。

“谁！”
邢兆福脸色一变，铿锵一声拔刀在手，几步就冲到了庭院之内。
content_en:
The days passed.
Su Mu went out early and came back late every day, rain or shine, perfectly performing his duties as a hunter.
Points are also slowly accumulating.
Fubo Sword Technique requires a lot of points from minor to advanced, three hundred points, which is five months of accumulation for Su Mu, and there is a long way to go.
Fortunately, the goal is clear and there is no wrong path. As long as you do your part well and persevere, you will reach your destination sooner or later.
After what Sun Dazhao was looking for last time, Su Mu deliberately kept a low profile.
He only brought a small part of the prey he caught every day back to the city, and discarded most of it.
Although it is a pity, it is always a good thing to be cautious in sailing the ship of ten thousand years.
He secretly inquired and found out that the hunters Sun Dazhao introduced to Mr. Xing had never come back since they went to Nancheng Division.
Su Mu guessed that they were already in danger.
Although money is good, it also needs life flowers.
Since then, he has become more and more cautious.
I don’t know if it’s because he hunts diligently enough, but the points on the panel increase at a slightly faster rate than before.
Now you can have five points in two days.
After a month, he had accumulated a total of seventy points.
"If this continues, in three months at most, I will be able to master the art of swordsmanship, and by then I will be considered a figure in Nancheng."
Su Mu thought to himself that after running around hunting outside the city for a whole day, he still felt a little tired even though he was much stronger now.
After fetching water and washing up, he lay on the bed and closed his eyes, recharging his energy for tomorrow's hunting.
…………
There are no stars tonight.
Looking down from the sky, the entire Wuling City was shrouded in darkness.
Unlike the brightly lit inner city, the outer city is almost entirely dark and silent.
There are only a few places where you can see the lights.
One of them is the Yamen of Nancheng Division.
Snap!
A teacup was thrown to the ground and shattered into pieces.
The tea in the cup splashed all over Xing Zhaofu, and the blue headhunter's uniform was soaked in large areas.
But this big shot, who could make Nancheng tremble with just a stomp of his feet, now had his head lowered, looking resigned.
To be able to make Xing Zhaofu, who is known as a poisonous snake, so obedient, the person who broke the teacup can naturally only be the number one figure in Nancheng Division, Nancheng Division Sima He Yuxing.
"Xing Zhaofu, you did a good job!"
He Yuxing's face was full of anger, he pointed at Xing Zhaofu and cursed, "In half a year, we have lost troops and generals, but the Black Dragon Village is still at large. The lead dog is better than you as the chief arrester!"
Xing Zhaofu had a bitter look on his face, "Sima, I have really tried my best. It is true that the leader of the Black Dragon Village is already a strong man in the third realm of Body Tempering, and the masters of the second and third villages are also in the second realm of Body Tempering.
In our Nancheng Division, except for me who is in the second level of Body Tempering, all the other warriors entering the country guessed that they were only in the first level of Body Tempering.
I can't beat him, I really can't beat him. "
"Those officers you recruited are just decorations? Even if you sacrifice your life for me, I will destroy the Black Dragon Village!"
He Yuxing's eyes flashed with strong murderous intent, "If we can't pacify Black Dragon Village, we'll blame the higher-ups. I'll be the first to deal with you!"
"Sima, the Black Dragon Village is very cunning. They hide in the deep mountains and old forests to attack us every time. But I have already thought of a way. I will recruit a group of hunters who are good at activities in the mountains and forests. With them leading the way, I will definitely be able to catch all the people in the Black Dragon Village!"
Xing Zhaofu said confidently.
"Hahaha, my general is defeated, what a big statement!"
At this moment, a burst of laughter suddenly sounded.
"Who!"
Xing Zhaofu's expression changed, he drew his sword in his hand with a clang, and rushed into the courtyard in a few steps.
